items.prompt: Failure to pull the Landing Gear switch out before up or down can break the switch.
There is no circuit breaker for the Electric trim - note position of the switch instead.

items.prompt: A pitot system drain valve is located on the forward bottom skin of the left wing just outboard of the wing root. The static system also has a drain just rearward of the left wing.

ON (3-5 SEC WITH MIXTURE RICH, THEN OFF)

CHECK (LANDING LIGHT ON, NEEDLE MOVES NEGATIVE)

items.prompt: Shutdown should have left Throttle for 1100RPM (< ¼ inch), do not touch throttle

SWITCH TANKS, VERIFY ENGINE RUNS ON EACH, RETURN TO FULLER TANK

items.prompt: Fuel Selector - do not switch tank

items.expectation: CHECK EGT ALL CYL(MAX 175 RPM, DIFF 50 RPM)
CYCLE 3X, RETURN TO HIGH RPM (CHECK MP RISES)

items.prompt: There is no alternator field switch, check alternator through load only, DO NOT turn of master.

items.expectation: PRESS AND HOLD TEST - 5 BEEPS, VERIFY ALL ANNUNCIATORS FLASH & TURN OFF
FORWARD & AFT - VERIFY NO TRIM MOVEMENT
FORWARD & AFT - VERIFY NO TRIM MOVEMENT
VERIFY TRIM WHEEL RUNS NOSE DOWN
VERIFY TRIM WHEEL RUNS NOSE UP
HOLD DISC & ACTUATE MET - VERIFY NO MOVEMENT
ROTATE LEFT & RIGHT - VERIFY YOKE FOLLOWS BUG
PRESS & HOLD - VERIFY SERVOS RELEASE, RELEASE TO RE-ENGAGE
HOLD PITCH UP/DOWN - VERIFY TRIM WHEEL RUNS AFTER 3 SEC
PRESS - VERIFY AP DISENGAGES & TONE SOUNDS
FULL RICH (LEAN ABOVE 5000 MSL FOR MAX POWER)
LEAN TO PEAK EGT OR 50-100°F ROP

items.prompt: Retarding throttle below 12" MP causes gear warning horn if gear retracted.
Avoid continuous operation between 1500-1950 RPM below 15" MP

items.expectation: CHECK GEAR DOWN LIGHT & VISUAL FLOOR INDICATOR
CHECK GEAR DOWN LIGHT & VISUAL FLOOR INDICATOR

items.prompt: Maximum performance landing: 65 KIAS on final, full flaps, main wheels first, maximum braking without locking wheels.
Crosswind landing: approach above normal speed with full flaps (use 1/2 flaps if the crosswind component exceeds 12 KTS).

items.expectation: RETRACT TO TAKEOFF (15°) AFTER CLIMB ESTABLISHED
NOSE DOWN TO REDUCE CONTROL FORCE
SET FOR 1100 RPM (UNTIL CHT STARTS TO DROP)

items.prompt: FPI: HOLD L BUTTON DOWN TACH
FPI: In LVK Hangar - Nothing Further
FPI: Temporary Shelter, Ramp or Cross-Country

items.expectation: ADJUST VIA CWS OR VS ENGAGEMENT
PRESS ALT ON KAP 150 AT DESIRED ALTITUDE
VERIFY AIRCRAFT IN TRIM (NO UP/DN TRIM WARNINGS)

checklists.title: Failure of Landing Gear to Extend Electrically

items.prompt: Do not operate the landing gear electrically with the manual extension system engaged.
Slowly pull T-Handle 1-2 inches to rotate clutch mechanism and allow it to engage drive shaft

items.expectation: PULL 12-20 INCHES & RETURN, REPEAT UNTIL GEAR DOWN & LOCKED (STOP WHEN RESISTANCE IS FELT)
RETURN TO NORMAL POSITION & SECURE WITH LATCH

items.prompt: Malfunction of the landing gear requires maintenance inspection and repair before the electrical system is used.

checklists.title: Failure to Retract Landing Gear Electrically

items.prompt: Indication: GR SAFETY BY PASS annunciator, both gear annunciator lights illuminated and gear warning horn sounding.
GEAR UNSAFE and GEAR DOWN lights
Check AIRSPEED safety switch as soon as practicable
If above procedures do not initiate retraction process, check emergency manual extension lever on floor for proper position.
Quits on one magneto? Throttle idle and mixture cutoff BEFORE turning magnetos back ON (backfire).
Severe roughness can cause propeller separation. Do not continue unless no alternative.

items.expectation: READJUST TO POWER SETTING IN USE
CHECK IF MIXTURE READJUSTMENT IS INEFFECTIVE
R, THEN L, THEN BOTH (IF ROUGHNESS CLEARS ON ONE MAGNETO: ADJUST POWER & CONTINUE)

items.prompt: If Severe Roughness Cannot Be Eliminated

items.expectation: READJUST TO PROPER FUEL FLOW FOR POWER IN USE
REDUCE IF TEMPERATURE CANNOT BE MAINTAINED WITHIN LIMITS

items.prompt: Prolonged high oil temperature is usually accompanied by a drop in oil pressure. If oil pressure remains normal, a high temperature indication may be caused by a faulty gauge or thermocouple.

items.expectation: PREPARE FOR POSSIBLE ENGINE FAILURE IF TEMPERATURE CONTINUES HIGH
EXPECT ENGINE FAILURE - PROCEED TO FORCED LANDING WITHOUT POWER

items.prompt: Probable when the engine only operates with the boost pump ON. Operate the engine controls smoothly: lean the mixture when retarding the throttle or reducing engine speed, enrich it when opening the throttle or increasing engine speed. Always lean to obtain a smooth running engine.

items.expectation: INCREASE UNTIL ENGINE STARTS, ADJUST FOR SMOOTH OPERATION
AS REQUIRED TO MAINTAIN RPM BELOW 2700
AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE IF CONDITION PERSISTS

items.prompt: Use whenever the normal static sources are suspected to be blocked. The airspeed indicator, altimeter and rate-of-climb then sense cabin interior pressure.

items.expectation: PULL ON (VALVE LOWER LEFT OF PILOT'S PANEL, ABOVE LEFT KNEE)

items.prompt: NOT AN EMERGENCY. Many fatal accidents began with loss of control closing a door. Return and land.
If practicable, have a passenger hold the door during the landing flare.
Only If Return Is Impractical: Close Door At Safe Altitude

items.expectation: RIGHT SIDESLIP (RIGHT BANK WITH LEFT RUDDER)

items.prompt: Do not operate in known icing conditions.

items.expectation: OFF (DO NOT TURN ON AGAIN IN CLEAR AIR UNTIL ALL ICE & SNOW HAS MELTED)
OFF UNTIL ENGINE OPERATION IS NORMAL
LOWER NOSE, 91 KIAS (BEST GLIDE, MAX GROSS)

items.prompt: If Engine Does Not Restart - Power Off Landing:
Gear DOWN for paved runway or smooth surface; Gear UP for rough fields, soft ground, or trees

items.expectation: CHECK ON BOTH (START IF PROPELLER STOPPED)
ADVANCE SLOWLY TOWARD RICH UNTIL ENGINE STARTS
RETARD TO DESIRED POWER (WHEN ENGINE STARTS)
RE-ESTABLISH, THEN LEAN MIXTURE AS REQUIRED

items.prompt: If the engine does not restart, establish best glide speed and proceed to Forced Landing Without Power.
Gear DOWN for paved runway or smooth surface; Gear UP for rough fields, soft ground, or trees

items.expectation: DOWN OR UP, DEPENDING ON TERRAIN

items.prompt: If the fire is not extinguished, attempt to increase airflow over the engine by increasing glide speed and opening the cowl flaps. Plan a power-off landing. Do not attempt an engine restart.
Stall warning and gear warning are not available with the Master Switch OFF.

items.expectation: CHECK TO IDENTIFY FAULTY CIRCUIT (DO NOT RESET)
ON ONE AT A TIME, SHORT PAUSE BETWEEN

items.prompt: A tripped main alternator circuit breaker can only be caused by a shorted alternator circuit and cannot be corrected by resetting the breaker. Verify by attempting to reset it no more than once. If that fails, pull the alternator field breaker, turn off all non-essential electrical equipment and terminate the flight as soon as practical.

items.expectation: RELEASE WHILE OBSERVING PITCH TRIM WHEEL
IF IN MOTION, FOLLOW ELECTRIC TRIM MALFUNCTION

items.prompt: Electric Trim Malfunction (Manual Electric or Autotrim):
Hold wheel firmly when disconnecting: up to 45 lb of force may be needed to hold level.
Maximum altitude loss from an autopilot malfunction: cruise, climb or descent 400 ft; maneuvering 90 ft; approach 90 ft.

items.expectation: AS REQUIRED TO MAINTAIN CHT 300°F (149°C) MINIMUM

items.prompt: About 2,000 fpm or more is achievable either gear and flaps up at 195 KIAS or gear down at 132 KIAS. At 132 KIAS the descent angle is steeper (less distance covered), the ride is smoother and pilot workload is lower.
When Sure Of Making The Landing Area (Firm Sod Or Foamed Runway Recommended):
Intentional spins are prohibited. Up to 2,000 feet of altitude may be lost in a one-turn spin and recovery.

items.expectation: FULL RUDDER OPPOSITE THE DIRECTION OF SPIN
FORWARD OF NEUTRAL, BRISKLY (MORE FORWARD IF ROTATION DOES NOT STOP)

items.prompt: Hold the anti-spin controls until rotation stops.

items.expectation: IF EXTENDED, RETRACT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE
SMOOTHLY AFT TO LEVEL FLIGHT ATTITUDE
